title: Create
description: Adds a new Markdown file to the sidebar without closing your current document.

title: Open
description: Import a .md file or a WorkFlow container (.mdu.json).

title: Save
description: Export as Markdown, PDF via print, or a full WorkFlow backup.

title: How to Use
description: Starts this guided tour. The app never runs it automatically.

title: Diagnostics
description: Inspect recent structured events from the in-app flight recorder.

title: Workspace
description: Files and folders, newest first. Use + for folders, ⋮ on folders, drag to reorder or nest.

title: New folder
description: Creates a folder at the workspace root.

title: Preview
description: Rendered preview with a transparent source layer so you can still edit.

title: Editor
description: Edit in any view mode. Use the tools sidebar for formatting.

title: Tools
description: Open the resizable Markdown tools panel on the right.

title: Editor tools
description: Select text, then apply Bold, lists, tables, math, and more. Drag the left edge to resize.
